subject: sub-01
note: NOT patient data. This is a phantom in a BIDS-SHAPED directory (sub-<label>/<datatype>/<file>) so the same loader path the app uses can be exercised with no download. It is not a BIDS-conformant dataset: BIDS describes participant data. The phantom's proliferation and vasculature are synthetic, the engine constants are declared assumptions, and no number a run produces is a clinical prediction.
